pose_tracking_synthetic.description: Arm pose tracking with 10-fold leave-one-synthetic-subject-out substitute data; lower joint-position error indicates better wearable pose estimation.

median_elbow_cm.description: Median 3-D elbow position error at the target output frame.

median_wrist_cm.description: Median 3-D wrist position error at the target output frame.

median_elbow_wrist_cm.description: Headline central pose error over elbow and wrist predictions.

mean_elbow_wrist_cm.description: Average elbow/wrist position error, adding sensitivity to broad degradation hidden by medians.

p90_elbow_wrist_cm.description: Ninetieth-percentile elbow/wrist error to catch methods that only optimize typical poses.

high_motion_mean_elbow_wrist_cm.description: Mean elbow/wrist error on the highest-motion quartile of windows.

forearm_length_mae_cm.description: Predicted forearm-length error, penalizing geometrically implausible pose shortcuts.

param_count_k.description: Trainable parameter count in thousands, preserving the small-model constraint.

uwb_correction_synthetic.description: UWB correction quality; better methods reduce noisy phone-watch range error without only improving easy samples.

raw_uwb_mae_cm.description: Mean raw range error before correction, reported only as context for correction difficulty.

corrected_uwb_mae_cm.description: Headline mean absolute error after range correction.

corrected_uwb_p90_cm.description: Ninetieth-percentile corrected range error, detecting brittle correction on difficult samples.

uwb_improvement_cm.description: Mean error reduction from raw to corrected range.

hard_uwb_improvement_cm.description: Error reduction on the highest raw-error quartile, targeting occlusion-like range failures.

uwb_correction_win_rate.description: Fraction of evaluated windows where correction improves over the raw range.
